query.name: com.unorth.teacher_grade_analytics.teacher_sections_by_email
query.description: Returns current rostered sections and Student Numbers for one teacher matched by exact school email. Student Numbers are used server-side only to compute roster counts.
query.sql: SELECT USERS.DCID, USERS.FIRST_NAME, USERS.LAST_NAME, USERS.EMAIL_ADDR, SCHOOLSTAFF.ID, SECTIONS.ID, SECTIONS.COURSE_NUMBER, SECTIONS.ROOM, SECTIONS.EXPRESSION, COURSES.COURSE_NAME, STUDENTS.STUDENT_NUMBER FROM USERS JOIN SCHOOLSTAFF ON SCHOOLSTAFF.USERS_DCID = USERS.DCID JOIN SECTIONS ON SECTIONS.TEACHER = SCHOOLSTAFF.ID LEFT JOIN COURSES ON COURSES.COURSE_NUMBER = SECTIONS.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN CC ON CC.SECTIONID = SECTIONS.ID AND CC.DATEENROLLED <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND CC.DATELEFT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) JOIN STUDENTS ON STUDENTS.ID = CC.STUDENTID AND STUDENTS.ENROLL_STATUS = 0 WHERE LOWER(USERS.EMAIL_ADDR) = LOWER(:teacher_email) ORDER BY SECTIONS.COURSE_NUMBER, SECTIONS.EXPRESSION, SECTIONS.ID, STUDENTS.STUDENT_NUMBER
